policy_text: Combined pathological rate <10% → PROCEED clean; 10–25% → PROCEED with caveat; >25% → STOP. Per-session minimum ≥40 usable frames.
caveat: D2 block 2 (rows 2796-3196) shows elevated pathological rate (30%) — likely Mask R-CNN under-performs on supine/horizontal yoga poses (less represented in COCO training). V10 block 2 (rows 2345-2595) shows 0% pathological. Scope of proper-segmentation analysis excludes the D2 block 2 supine-pose subset.
